Add a read-only `stats` command that reports total, pending, completed, and completion percentage rounded to one decimal using invariant formatting. Also report counts created on each UTC calendar date, ordered ascending; empty storage must produce zeros and an empty date list. Support `--json` with stable property names and types, and ensure the command never rewrites storage. +            $invariant = [System.Globalization.CultureInfo]::InvariantCulture
+            $tasks = @(Read-TaskStore -Path $dataFile)

+            $completed = @($tasks | Where-Object { [string]$_.status -eq 'completed' }).Count
+            $pending = @($tasks | Where-Object { [string]$_.status -eq 'pending' }).Count

+
+            $byDate = @(
+                $tasks |
+                    ForEach-Object {
+                        $parsed = [DateTimeOffset]::Parse([string]$_.createdAt, $invariant, [System.Globalization.DateTimeStyles]::RoundtripKind)
+                        $parsed.UtcDateTime.ToString('yyyy-MM-dd', $invariant)
+                    } |
+                    Group-Object |
+                    Sort-Object -Property Name |
+                    ForEach-Object { [ordered]@{ date = [string]$_.Name; count = [int]$_.Count } }
+            )
+
+            if ($asJson) {
+                $result = [ordered]@{
+                    total = [int]$total
+                    pending = [int]$pending
+                    completed = [int]$completed
+                    completionPercentage = [double]$percentage
+                    byDate = @($byDate | ForEach-Object { [pscustomobject]$_ })
+                }
+                Write-TaskForgeOutput -Value ([pscustomobject]$result) -AsJson $true
+            }
+            else {
+                $percentageText = ([double]$percentage).ToString('0.0', $invariant)
+                $bannerPath = Join-Path (Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot) 'assets/stats.txt'
+                if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $bannerPath) {
+                    Get-Content -LiteralPath $bannerPath
+                }
+                "Total tasks: $total"
+                "Pending: $pending"
+                "Completed: $completed"
+                "Completion: $percentageText%"
+                'By UTC date:'
+                if ($byDate.Count -eq 0) {
+                    '  (none)'
+                }
+                else {
+                    $byDate | ForEach-Object { "  {0}: {1}" -f $_.date, $_.count }
+                }
+            }
+        }

             Assert-KnownOptions -Options $options -Allowed @()
             @'

[CmdletBinding()]
param()

Set-StrictMode -Version Latest
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'

$scriptPath = Join-Path (Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot) 'src/TaskForge.ps1'
$benchmarkRoot = Split-Path -Parent (Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot)
$temporaryRoot = Join-Path $benchmarkRoot ".scratch/fixture/taskforge-base-$([guid]::NewGuid())"
$dataFile = Join-Path $temporaryRoot 'tasks.json'
$failures = [System.Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new()
$script:assertions = 0

function Assert-True {
    param([bool]$Condition, [string]$Message)
    $script:assertions++
    if (-not $Condition) {
        $failures.Add($Message)
    }
}

function Invoke-TaskForge {
    param([string[]]$Arguments)
    $output = @(& $PSHOME\pwsh -NoProfile -File $scriptPath @Arguments 2>&1)
    [pscustomobject]@{
        ExitCode = $LASTEXITCODE
        Output = ($output -join "`n")
    }
}

try {
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $temporaryRoot -Force | Out-Null

    $add = Invoke-TaskForge @('add', '--title', 'First task', '--description', 'Fixture test', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($add.ExitCode -eq 0) 'add should succeed'
    $added = $add.Output | ConvertFrom-Json
    Assert-True ($added.id -eq 1 -and $added.status -eq 'pending') 'add should return a pending task with ID 1'

    $list = Invoke-TaskForge @('list', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($list.ExitCode -eq 0) 'list should succeed'
    Assert-True (@($list.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).Count -eq 1) 'list should return the stored task'

    $complete = Invoke-TaskForge @('complete', '--id', '1', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($complete.ExitCode -eq 0) 'complete should succeed'
    Assert-True (($complete.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).status -eq 'completed') 'complete should persist completed status'

    $missing = Invoke-TaskForge @('complete', '--id', '99', '--data-file', $dataFile)
    Assert-True ($missing.ExitCode -ne 0) 'completing an unknown task should fail'

    $remove = Invoke-TaskForge @('remove', '--id', '1', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($remove.ExitCode -eq 0) 'remove should succeed'
    Assert-True (($remove.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).removedId -eq 1) 'remove should report the removed ID'

    $empty = Invoke-TaskForge @('list', '--data-file', $dataFile)
    Assert-True ($empty.Output -eq 'No tasks.') 'empty list should have stable text'

    $help = Invoke-TaskForge @('help')
    Assert-True ($help.ExitCode -eq 0 -and $help.Output.Contains('TaskForge')) 'help should succeed'
    Assert-True ($help.Output.Contains('stats')) 'help should advertise the stats command'

    # --- stats command: empty storage ---
    $statsFile = Join-Path $temporaryRoot 'stats-empty.json'
    $statsEmptyJson = Invoke-TaskForge @('stats', '--data-file', $statsFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($statsEmptyJson.ExitCode -eq 0) 'stats should succeed on empty storage'
    $se = $statsEmptyJson.Output | ConvertFrom-Json
    Assert-True ($se.total -eq 0 -and $se.pending -eq 0 -and $se.completed -eq 0) 'empty stats should report zero counts'
    Assert-True ($se.completionPercentage -eq 0) 'empty stats completion percentage should be zero'
    Assert-True (@($se.byDate).Count -eq 0) 'empty stats byDate should be empty'
    Assert-True (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $statsFile)) 'stats must not create storage when none exists'

    # --- stats command: populated storage, JSON shape ---
    $statsData = Join-Path $temporaryRoot 'stats-data.json'
    Invoke-TaskForge @('add', '--title', 'Alpha', '--data-file', $statsData, '--json') | Out-Null
    Invoke-TaskForge @('add', '--title', 'Bravo', '--data-file', $statsData, '--json') | Out-Null
    Invoke-TaskForge @('add', '--title', 'Charlie', '--data-file', $statsData, '--json') | Out-Null
    Invoke-TaskForge @('complete', '--id', '1', '--data-file', $statsData, '--json') | Out-Null

    $before = Get-Content -LiteralPath $statsData -Raw
    $statsJson = Invoke-TaskForge @('stats', '--data-file', $statsData, '--json')
    $after = Get-Content -LiteralPath $statsData -Raw
    Assert-True ($statsJson.ExitCode -eq 0) 'populated stats should succeed'
    Assert-True ($before -eq $after) 'stats must never rewrite storage'
    $sj = $statsJson.Output | ConvertFrom-Json
    Assert-True ($sj.total -eq 3 -and $sj.completed -eq 1 -and $sj.pending -eq 2) 'stats should report correct counts'
    Assert-True ($sj.completionPercentage -eq 33.3) 'completion percentage should round to one decimal'
    Assert-True (-not ($statsJson.Output.Contains('STATS'))) 'JSON stats output must be banner-free'

    # --- stats command: non-JSON output shows banner before the dashboard ---
    $statsText = Invoke-TaskForge @('stats', '--data-file', $statsData)
    Assert-True ($statsText.ExitCode -eq 0) 'text stats should succeed'
    $bannerIndex = $statsText.Output.IndexOf('STATS')
    $totalIndex = $statsText.Output.IndexOf('Total tasks:')
    Assert-True ($bannerIndex -ge 0) 'text stats should include the STATS banner'
    Assert-True ($totalIndex -ge 0 -and $bannerIndex -lt $totalIndex) 'banner should appear before the dashboard'
    Assert-True ($statsText.Output.Contains('33.3%')) 'text stats should show invariant percentage'

    # --- stats command: UTC calendar grouping ordered ascending ---
    $mixedData = Join-Path $temporaryRoot 'stats-mixed.json'
    $mixed = @'
[
  {"id":1,"title":"a","description":"","status":"completed","createdAt":"2026-07-27T10:00:00.0000000+00:00"},
  {"id":2,"title":"b","description":"","status":"pending","createdAt":"2026-07-29T23:30:00.0000000+00:00"},
  {"id":3,"title":"c","description":"","status":"pending","createdAt":"2026-07-27T23:00:00.0000000+00:00"},
  {"id":4,"title":"d","description":"","status":"completed","createdAt":"2026-07-28T05:00:00.0000000+00:00"},
  {"id":5,"title":"e","description":"","status":"pending","createdAt":"2026-07-30T01:30:00.0000000+05:00"}
]
'@
    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($mixedData, $mixed)
    $mixedStats = Invoke-TaskForge @('stats', '--data-file', $mixedData, '--json')
    Assert-True ($mixedStats.ExitCode -eq 0) 'mixed-date stats should succeed'
    $ms = $mixedStats.Output | ConvertFrom-Json
    $dates = @($ms.byDate | ForEach-Object { $_.date })
    $counts = @($ms.byDate | ForEach-Object { $_.count })
    Assert-True (($dates -join ',') -eq '2026-07-27,2026-07-28,2026-07-29') 'byDate should be UTC calendar dates in ascending order'
    Assert-True (($counts -join ',') -eq '2,1,2') 'byDate counts should reflect UTC grouping'
    Assert-True ($ms.total -eq 5 -and $ms.completionPercentage -eq 40.0) 'mixed stats totals and percentage should be correct'

    # --- assets/stats.txt banner asset constraints ---
    $bannerPath = Join-Path (Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot) 'assets/stats.txt'
    Assert-True (Test-Path -LiteralPath $bannerPath) 'assets/stats.txt should exist'
    $bytes = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($bannerPath)
    $bannerText = [System.Text.Encoding]::ASCII.GetString($bytes)
    Assert-True ($bannerText.EndsWith("`n") -and -not $bannerText.EndsWith("`n`n")) 'banner should end with exactly one newline'
    Assert-True (-not $bannerText.Contains("`r")) 'banner should use LF line endings'
    $bannerLines = $bannerText.TrimEnd("`n") -split "`n"
    Assert-True ($bannerLines.Count -eq 12) 'banner should contain exactly 12 lines'
    Assert-True ($bannerText.Contains('STATS')) 'banner should contain the literal STATS'
    $allowed = 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789+|/\_*.#(): =-'
    $bannerOk = $true
    foreach ($line in $bannerLines) {
        if ($line.Length -lt 20 -or $line.Length -gt 48) { $bannerOk = $false }
        if ($line -ne $line.TrimEnd()) { $bannerOk = $false }
        foreach ($ch in [char[]]$line) {
            if ([int]$ch -gt 127 -or $allowed.IndexOf($ch) -lt 0) { $bannerOk = $false }
        }
    }
    Assert-True $bannerOk 'every banner line should satisfy length and character constraints'

    if ($failures.Count -gt 0) {
        $failures | ForEach-Object { [Console]::Error.WriteLine("FAIL: $_") }
        exit 1
    }
    "PASS: $script:assertions fixture assertions"
}
finally {
    Remove-Item -LiteralPath $temporaryRoot -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
}
